<span data-mw='{"caption":"Map of RAAF area commands in 1944"}' typeof="mw:File"><a class="mw-file-description" data-relay-id="e88" href="https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/File:RAAFAreaCommands1944.png" title="Map of RAAF area commands in 1944"><img alt="Map of RAAF area commands in 1944" class="mw-file-element" data-file-height="323" data-file-type="bitmap" data-file-width="319" decoding="async" height="141" loading="lazy" resource="https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/File:RAAFAreaCommands1944.png" src="assets/2b117a95294ef8846e9c559e.webp" width="139"/></a></span><div class="thumbcaption" style="padding: 0.25em 0; word-wrap: break-word; ">Map of RAAF area commands in 1944</div></div></div><span about="#mwt7">
</span><p about="#mwt7"><b><a data-relay-id="e89" href="https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/RAAF_area_commands" rel="mw:WikiLink" title="RAAF area commands">Area commands</a></b> were the major operational and administrative formations of the <a data-relay-id="e90" href="https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Royal_Australian_Air_Force" rel="mw:WikiLink" title="Royal Australian Air Force">Royal Australian Air Force</a> (RAAF) between 1940 and 1954. Four commands were raised in 1940, early in World War<span typeof="mw:Entity"> </span>II, to oversee operations, training and maintenance within their geographical boundaries. In 1941–42 the structure was revised to make a total of five commands, along with four <a data-relay-id="e91" href="https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Group_(military_unit)" rel="mw:WikiLink" title="Group (military unit)">functional groups</a> that assumed the training and maintenance roles. The area commands focused on operations until the end of hostilities. A <a data-relay-id="e92" href="https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Northern_Command_(RAAF)" rel="mw:WikiLink" title="Northern Command (RAAF)">new area command covering RAAF units in New Guinea</a> existed from 1944 to 1947. By the early 1950s, the area command structure was no longer considered appropriate, and in 1953 it was transformed into <a data-relay-id="e93" href="https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/RAAF_Air_Command" rel="mw:WikiLink" title="RAAF Air Command">Home Command</a> (controlling operations), <a data-relay-id="e94" href="https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Air_Force_Training_Group_RAAF" rel="mw:WikiLink" title="Air Force Training Group RAAF">Training Command</a>, and <a data-relay-id="e95" href="https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/RAAF_Support_Command" rel="mw:WikiLink" title="RAAF Support Command">Maintenance Command</a>. The area commands ceded their authority to these functional commands in 1954, and were disbanded by the end of 1956. <i>(<b><a data-relay-id="e96" href="https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/RAAF_area_commands" rel="mw:WikiLink" title="RAAF area commands">This<span typeof="mw:Entity"> </span>article</a></b> is part of a <a data-relay-id="e97" href="https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Wikipedia:Featured_topics" rel="mw:WikiLink" title="Wikipedia:Featured topics">featured topic</a>: <b><a data-relay-id="e98" href="https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Wikipedia:Featured_topics/RAAF_area_commands" rel="mw:WikiLink" title="Wikipedia:Featured topics/RAAF area commands"><i>RAAF area commands</i></a></b>.)</i></p><span about="#mwt7">

<h2 class="mp-h2 mw-html-heading" id="mp-dyk-h2">Did you know<span id="mwFA" typeof="mw:Entity"> </span>...</h2>

<div class="thumbinner mp-thumb" style="background: transparent; color: inherit; border: none; padding: 0; max-width: 123px;">
<span data-mw='{"caption":"Achilles Schucan"}' typeof="mw:File"><a class="mw-file-description" data-relay-id="e106" href="https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/File:Achilles_Schucan,_erster_Direktor_Rhätische_Bahn.png" title="Achilles Schucan"><img alt="Achilles Schucan" class="mw-file-element" data-file-height="803" data-file-type="bitmap" data-file-width="624" decoding="async" height="158" loading="lazy" resource="https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/File:Achilles_Schucan,_erster_Direktor_Rhätische_Bahn.png" src="assets/80310e856dedc0befd95bc8c.webp" width="123"/></a></span><div class="thumbcaption" style="padding: 0.25em 0; word-wrap: break-word; ">Achilles Schucan</div></div></div><ul about="#mwt10"><li>... that one of the <a data-relay-id="e107" href="https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Rhaetian_Railway" rel="mw:WikiLink" title="Rhaetian Railway">Rhaetian Railway</a>'s trains is named after <b><a data-relay-id="e108" href="https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Achilles_Schucan" rel="mw:WikiLink" title="Achilles Schucan">Achilles Schucan</a></b> <i>(pictured)</i>, its first director?</li>
<li>... that the <b><a data-relay-id="e109" href="https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/2003_Siberian_taiga_wildfires" rel="mw:WikiLink" title="2003 Siberian taiga wildfires">2003 Siberian taiga wildfires</a></b> caused bears and tigers to move into populated areas?</li>
<li>... that <b><a data-relay-id="e110" href="https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Oleksandr_Demenko" rel="mw:WikiLink" title="Oleksandr Demenko">Oleksandr Demenko</a></b> was wounded in the <a data-relay-id="e111" href="https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Siege_of_Mariupol" rel="mw:WikiLink" title="Siege of Mariupol">siege of Mariupol</a> and held captive by Russia for 20 months, and now leads an NGO for Ukrainian LGBTQ soldiers and veterans?</li>
<li>... that the San Diego Zoo made a special bread for the panda <b><a data-relay-id="e112" href="https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Yun_Zi" rel="mw:WikiLink" title="Yun Zi">Yun Zi</a></b>, instead of kibble, to prepare him for his time in China?</li>
<li>... that although <b><a data-relay-id="e113" href="https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/George_Leonard_Huxley" rel="mw:WikiLink" title="George Leonard Huxley">George Leonard Huxley</a></b> was leading academic initiatives and civil rights efforts in Ireland in the 1960s and 1970s, he did not become a citizen of Ireland until 2018?</li>
<li>... that a French translation of <i><b><a data-relay-id="e114" href="https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The_Sound_Pattern_of_English" rel="mw:WikiLink" title="The Sound Pattern of English">The Sound Pattern of English</a></b></i> includes only chapters 1, 2, 7, 8, and 9?</li>
<li>... that Swiss architect <b><a data-relay-id="e115" href="https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ferdinand_Stadler" rel="mw:WikiLink" title="Ferdinand Stadler">Ferdinand Stadler</a></b> was awarded the first prize in a <a data-relay-id="e116" href="https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Federal_Palace_of_Switzerland" rel="mw:WikiLink" title="Federal Palace of Switzerland">Federal Palace</a> competition in Bern, but the project was instead awarded to an architect who had not even entered?</li>
<li>... that students from Harvard and Yale enlisted as strikebreakers during the <b><a data-relay-id="e117" href="https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/1912_Boston_streetcar_strike" rel="mw:WikiLink" title="1912 Boston streetcar strike">1912 Boston streetcar strike</a></b>?</li>
<li>... that <b><a data-relay-id="e118" href="https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Alirio_García_Flamenco" rel="mw:WikiLink" title="Alirio García Flamenco">Alirio García Flamenco</a></b> found serving in the <a data-relay-id="e119" href="https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Iraq_War" rel="mw:WikiLink" title="Iraq War">Iraq War</a> to be more comfortable than the extreme heat that he experienced in <a data-relay-id="e120" href="https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Western_Sahara" rel="mw:WikiLink" title="Western Sahara">Western Sahara</a>?</li></ul><span about="#mwt10">
</span><link about="#mwt10" data-mw='{"name":"templatestyles","attrs":{"src":"Hlist/styles.css"}}' href="mw-data:TemplateStyles:r1374427404" rel="mw-deduplicated-inline-style" typeof="mw:Extension/templatestyles"/><div about="#mwt10" class="hlist dyk-footer noprint" id="mwFg" style=" margin-top: 0.5em; text-align: right;">

<div class="mp-contains-float" id="mp-tfl"><div id="mp-tfl-img" style="float:right;margin:0.5em 0 0.4em 0.9em;"><div class="thumbinner mp-thumb" style="background: transparent; color: inherit; border: none; padding: 0; max-width: 128px;">
<span data-mw='{"caption":"<a rel=\"mw:WikiLink\" href=\"./Dimitar_Berbatov\" title=\"Dimitar Berbatov\" id=\"mwIA\">Dimitar Berbatov</a>"}' typeof="mw:File"><a class="mw-file-description" data-relay-id="e187" href="https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/File:Mitko_Berbatov_cropped.jpg" title="Dimitar Berbatov"><img alt="Dimitar Berbatov" class="mw-file-element" data-file-height="1822" data-file-type="bitmap" data-file-width="1534" decoding="async" height="152" loading="lazy" resource="https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/File:Mitko_Berbatov_cropped.jpg" src="assets/e39cd157e514c6ea20808bf1.webp" width="128"/></a></span><div class="thumbcaption" style="padding: 0.25em 0; word-wrap: break-word; "><a data-relay-id="e188" href="https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Dimitar_Berbatov" rel="mw:WikiLink" title="Dimitar Berbatov">Dimitar Berbatov</a></div></div></div>
<p>From 1999 to 2010, <b><a data-relay-id="e189" href="https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_international_goals_scored_by_Dimitar_Berbatov" rel="mw:WikiLink" title="List of international goals scored by Dimitar Berbatov">Bulgarian footballer Dimitar Berbatov scored 48 international goals in 78 appearances</a></b>, playing for the <a data-relay-id="e190" href="https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Bulgaria_national_football_team" rel="mw:WikiLink" title="Bulgaria national football team">Bulgarian national team</a> as the <a data-relay-id="e191" href="https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Forward_(association_football)" rel="mw:WikiLink" title="Forward (association football)">forward</a>, finishing as the joint all-time top scorer for the team along with <a data-relay-id="e192" href="https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Hristo_Bonev" rel="mw:WikiLink" title="Hristo Bonev">Hristo Bonev</a>. Making his debut against <a data-relay-id="e193" href="https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Greece_national_football_team" rel="mw:WikiLink" title="Greece national football team">Greece</a> in November<span typeof="mw:Entity"> </span>1999, he scored his first goal for the team in February<span typeof="mw:Entity"> </span>2000 in a <a data-relay-id="e194" href="https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Exhibition_game" rel="mw:WikiLink" title="Exhibition game">friendly</a> against <a data-relay-id="e195" href="https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Chile_national_football_team" rel="mw:WikiLink" title="Chile national football team">Chile</a>. In 2007, he scored twice in the final of the <a data-relay-id="e196" href="https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Cyprus_International_Football_Tournament" rel="mw:WikiLink" title="Cyprus International Football Tournament">Cyprus International Football Tournament</a> to give him his only title with the team. In the penultimate year of his international career, he scored his sole <a data-relay-id="e197" href="https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Hat-trick#Association_football_(soccer)" rel="mw:WikiLink" title="Hat-trick">hat-trick</a> against <a data-relay-id="e198" href="https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Georgia_national_football_team" rel="mw:WikiLink" title="Georgia national football team">Georgia</a> in October<span typeof="mw:Entity"> </span>2009. Scoring his last two goals in a friendly against <a data-relay-id="e199" href="https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Malta_national_football_team" rel="mw:WikiLink" title="Malta national football team">Malta</a> in November of the same year, he retired from the team in February<span typeof="mw:Entity"> </span>2010, aged 29. (<b><a data-relay-id="e200" href="https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_international_goals_scored_by_Dimitar_Berbatov" rel="mw:WikiLink" title="List of international goals scored by Dimitar Berbatov">Full<span typeof="mw:Entity"> </span>list...</a></b>)</p>

<div id="mp-tfp"><table about="#mwt30" data-mw='{"parts":[{"template":{"target":{"wt":"#ifexist:Template:POTD protected/{{#time:Y-m-d}}","function":"ifexist"},"params":{"1":{"wt":"{{POTD protected/{{#time:Y-m-d}}}}"},"2":{"wt":"{{POTD protected/{{#time:Y-m-d|-1 day}}}}"}},"i":0}}]}' id="mwIg" role="presentation" style="margin:0 3px 3px; width:100%; box-sizing:border-box; text-align:left; border-collapse:collapse; " typeof="mw:Transclusion">
<tbody><tr><td style="padding:0 0.9em 0 0; width:400px;"><span data-mw='{"caption":"White-booted racket-tail"}' typeof="mw:File"><a class="mw-file-description" data-relay-id="e206" href="https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/File:White-booted_racket-tail_(Ocreatus_underwoodii_melanantherus)_male_in_flight_Paz_de_las_Aves.jpg" title="White-booted racket-tail"><img alt="White-booted racket-tail" class="mw-file-element" data-file-height="3632" data-file-type="bitmap" data-file-width="5448" decoding="async" height="267" loading="lazy" resource="https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/File:White-booted_racket-tail_(Ocreatus_underwoodii_melanantherus)_male_in_flight_Paz_de_las_Aves.jpg" src="assets/27467b86a5a46af07d1f76d2.webp" width="400"/></a></span></td>
<td style="padding:0 6px 0 0">
<p>The <b><a data-relay-id="e207" href="https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/White-booted_racket-tail" rel="mw:WikiLink" title="White-booted racket-tail">white-booted racket-tail</a></b> (<i>Ocreatus underwoodii</i>) is a species in the <a data-relay-id="e208" href="https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Hummingbird" rel="mw:WikiLink" title="Hummingbird">hummingbird</a> family, Trochilidae. It is found in Colombia, Ecuador and Venezuela, where it inhabits humid forests and forest edges, most commonly at elevations of 1,600 to 2,200 metres (5,200 to 7,200<span typeof="mw:Entity"> </span>ft). The species shows pronounced <a data-relay-id="e209" href="https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Sexual_dimorphism" rel="mw:WikiLink" title="Sexual dimorphism">sexual dimorphism</a>: males have elongated outer tail feathers with bare shafts ending in distinctive oval flags, while both sexes have white leg puffs. It feeds primarily on nectar, but also catches small insects in flight. The female lays two eggs in a tiny cup nest constructed from plant fibres and lichen. This male white-booted racket-tail of the subspecies <i>O.<span typeof="mw:Entity"> </span>u.<span typeof="mw:Entity"> </span>melanantherus</i> was photographed in <a data-relay-id="e210" href="https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Refugio_Paz_de_las_Aves" rel="mw:WikiLink" title="Refugio Paz de las Aves">Refugio Paz de las Aves</a>, a nature reserve in Ecuador, showing its green plumage and racket-shaped tail feathers while in flight.</p>
<p style="text-align:left;"><small>Photograph credit: <a data-relay-id="e211" href="https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/User:Charlesjsharp" rel="mw:WikiLink" title="User:Charlesjsharp">Charles J. Sharp</a></small></p>
